svg.title: Render time relative to memcpy across 3 core workloads and 11 showcase pages
svg.desc: Current canonical rendering table: November 14, 2026. Proa uses fresh owned RenderBuffer pages; peers retain their declared output policies. Copy controls captured 2026-11-11. Render and copy are separate captures, not paired samples. Each denominator copies the workload’s pre-rendered Proa HTML into a warmed, preallocated buffer; peer payload sizes can differ. Cards — Memcpy control: 1.00× memcpy, P50 262 ns, range 260 ns to 317 ns, 25,108 bytes; Proa: 4.26× memcpy, P50 1.12 µs, range 1.1 µs to 1.13 µs, 25,108 bytes; Marko: 40.1× memcpy, P50 10.5 µs, range 10.3 µs to 10.7 µs, 24,038 bytes; Matched Proa output allocation capture: Both variants return String and include allocation, page construction and runtime tags; these are String controls, not the native RenderBuffer scoreboard lane. Full-size rendering uses an exact-size contiguous Vec writer; the default uses 4 KiB chunks. Cards: default 1.25 µs (4.78× memcpy), full-size 750 ns (2.87× memcpy), copy 262 ns, speedup 1.67×. 96-product grid: default 18.3 µs (5.37× memcpy), full-size 9.21 µs (2.70× memcpy), copy 3.41 µs, speedup 1.99×. 1,000-row table: default 213 µs (18.1× memcpy), full-size 193 µs (16.4× memcpy), copy 11.8 µs, speedup 1.10×. Sentry OTel, 400 rows: default 110 µs (10.6× memcpy), full-size 118 µs (11.4× memcpy), copy 10.4 µs, speedup 0.93×. svg.text: P50 / hot-buffer copy · log scales · lower is better
Proa: fresh RenderBuffer · copy: 2026-11-11 · each floor copies the Proa payload
† Exact: JavaScript SSR with adapted styles and markup. Full-size capacity is known before timing. Copy: warmed, reused buffers; allocation excluded. Ranges: process
